subtitle: 3,600 Words, Parts 1-7 & Mocks
shortDescription: See your estimated score in 12 min. 3,600 words, Parts 1-7 practice, mock tests
promoText: Find out your estimated TOEIC score with the 12-minute Level Test. Then train with 3,600 words, Parts 1-7 practice, and 10 full + 10 half mock tests, all in one app.
description:
Prep for the TOEIC with a plan built around the score you need.
Vocab, Parts 1-7 practice, full and half mock tests and score estimates in one app.

■ Level Test (About 12 Minutes)
Answer 20 questions to see your estimated score, the points you still need, your weakest part and a personal study plan.

■ A Plan Built Around Your Target Score
Enter your target score (550-950+) and test date. ToeicFit picks only the words you need and sets your daily workload and finish date.
· 650: 1,070 basic words
· 700-800: 2,551 basic + core words
· 850 and up: all 3,600 words, adding high-scorer vocab (easiest first)

■ 90 Days, 3,600 Words, 3 Stages: Basic → Advanced → Test-Ready
Core TOEIC topics (hiring, HR, meetings, marketing, contracts, shipping, accounting, travel, hotels, IT, law, finance), high-frequency Part 5-6 verbs, adjectives, adverbs and idioms, LC phrasal verbs (fill in for, run late...) and Part 7 business vocabulary.
Every word has a TOEIC-style example with its meaning, collocations, word forms, Part 7 paraphrases and test tips.

■ Native Audio for Every Word and Sentence
All 3,600 words and 3,600 examples have audio, mixing American and British accents to match the Listening section.
On your commute, Word Listening Mode auto-plays each word, then its example (meanings stay on screen).

■ Review Right Before You Forget
Spaced repetition at 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30 days makes words stick. Missed words go to Mistakes until you get them right.

■ 3,500+ Part 5 Practice Questions
A Part 5-style question with an explanation for every word: parts of speech, preposition pairs and easily confused words.

■ Parts 1-7 Practice + Full and Half Mock Tests
· Part 3: 90 conversation sets · Part 4: 60 talk sets, including three-speaker conversations, implied-meaning questions and graphics (tables and charts)
· Part 5: 34 grammar lessons and 1,500 questions (Basics, Real Test and Advanced levels) · Part 5 vocabulary: 9 types, 900 questions + a timed 30-question set (10 min) · Part 6: 100 text-completion passages · Part 7: 140 reading sets (including double and triple passages)
· After grading, the sentence that proves the answer is highlighted in the script or passage, with explanations and paraphrase notes
· 10 full mock tests (200 questions in 2 hours, like the real test) and 10 half mocks, with estimated LC and RC scores and weak spots by question type
· Mock questions never repeat practice questions, so you're tested on questions you haven't seen
· Timed drills: 20 seconds per Part 5 question, real-test time limits for Parts 6 and 7
· Part 1: 195 photos (look at the photo, listen to four statements)
· Dictation and shadowing to sharpen your listening
※ All questions are newly written, test-style questions (not actual past exam questions).

■ 3-Min Vocab Check
30 questions find the levels you already know, so you skip ahead to the words you don't.

■ Targeted Training by Part
· 120 must-know Part 1 photo sentences (with the "is being + past participle" trap explained)
· 870 high-frequency LC Part 2-4 phrases across 29 topics by question type, situation and talk type, with questions and responses recorded in two voices
· LC quizzes: pick the best Part 2 response, choose the meaning of Part 3-4 lines, and retry your misses
· Part 7 synonym (paraphrase) quizzes
· 60 sets of easily confused Part 5 words (affect/effect, considerable/considerate...)

■ Also Included
A 3-day starter mission, on-screen tips and a User Guide, Study Stats and calendar, study streaks, a Daily Reminder, dark mode, offline use, and backup/restore

■ Pricing
Free to start: vocab Days 1-3, one practice set per part, the grammar basics plus one grammar topic, one vocab type, one half mock test, one try each at the LC quiz, dictation, Part 5 30-question test and Speed Drill, and the Level Test. Unlock everything with a one-time purchase that's yours for life. No subscription, no ads.

privacy.title: ToeicFit Privacy Policy
sections: ToeicFit (the "App") does not require account registration and does not collect any personal information, such as names, email addresses, phone numbers or location, nor does it transmit any such information to external servers.

Target score, test date, study history (review stage and number of correct answers for each word) and settings are stored solely on the user's device (in the App's local storage). This information is deleted when the App is uninstalled or when the user selects Settings > Reset Progress. Backup files are saved and managed by the user. If the user has Android (Google) backup turned on, the operating system may include this information in the user's own Google account backup, which is encrypted and controlled by the user and cannot be accessed by the developer.
Notifications: This permission is requested only if the user turns on Daily Reminder, and it is used solely to display study reminders at the time the user has selected.

The App does not use any advertising SDKs or analytics tools and does not share any information with third parties. Payments for paid features are processed through the Google Play and App Store payment systems, and the App does not receive any payment information.
